# Icon

Renders one of the 20 system icons as a single-ink mask so it takes currentColor — black on light surfaces, white or crimson-on-inverse on black.

`PhantomPortals.Icon` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.Icon name={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PhantomPortals.Icon" name="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One-ink icon that takes currentColor (the SVG is used as a mask). Decorative unless `label` is given.

## Props (IconProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `IconName` |  |
| `size` | `16 \| 20 \| 24` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
